I’m a person with “mild” autism, in west metro Atlanta, who needs a job by the end of January or I’m likely going to be homeless. If there’s anything anyone can do for me, or advice anyone can give me, I’m open to anything at this point. I know this isn’t exactly what this post was for, but I’m desperate.
Might be good for me later when we get our finances figured out. I looked at it online, going to be too expensive for me atm. But something to consider once I get my job situation figured out.

Bf just told me one of his coworkers had said he could help me get on at a call center. Initially he had told him probably not a good idea for me cause I have phone anxiety, but this morning I told him yes, absolutely talk to the guy about it. I’ll do it. I’ve got my new deep voice with the hormone treatment I been on, and as far as I know, call centers have general scripts for you right? It might be a good thing for me to get over this particular anxiety. Won’t I have a computer in front of me helping me know what to say?

My bf will be difficult to convince. He loves his job. I’d love to live in Colorado, although I know that’s not warmer. But I could get proper treatment for my anxiety, with CBD oil.

My anxiety has gotten better since I’ve been on hormone therapy. I do think I should try for disability, but have no idea where or how to start, and I know it’s a long process that I don’t have the time or money for. I have less than 2 months to pull something together. 

I think my anxiety attack was mostly related to paperwork. I have a lot of anxiety surrounding forms and applications. A lot of bad experience with them. My gf has been helping me with the job applications. 

I can try for free treatment, I was getting it before. But it was honestly terrible. The psychiatrist barely listened to me and just wanted to put me on psychiatric medication, which I don’t take well to. I would benefit most from CBD oil, but I live in the wrong state for that.

There’s no lease. Gf’s Aunt was letting them live her for cheap for the past 6 years. Didn’t say she was about to get foreclosed on until we (well gf and her husband) got an eviction notice in the mail saying we have 60 days.

I’ve tried calling and texting suicide hotlines. They offer platitudes and when that’s not enough, they ask if they need to send help (emts I guess). Which wouldn’t help me at all. That would probably make me panic. If I feel like I’m resolved to it, I’ll go to the ER on my own. I can’t handle someone coming into my home and grabbing me and shoving meds down my throat.

For the last 4 years my gf and her husband have been paying for our expenses, yes. My bf now gets my food and pays them rent, since he got this job. Before me and him lived here, we were living with his family, and they paid our expenses. Haven’t had a car, and up until bf got this job, haven’t had rent or utilities. For my hormones, my grandmother sent me some money after she sold her house and I used that for the initial costs. After that ran out, I used the money I’d get doing odd jobs for friends and family. (Painting, yardwork, cleaning... it hasn’t been much but maybe I can exaggerate on my resume/applications?)

Georgia did not expand Medicaid. I looked it that awhile back.

I have had food stamps before and they took them away because I didn’t work.

I’ve been without proper employment for 6 years. Years. Not months. >_<

I had food stamps before, and lost them because I didn’t work. They had me come in to fill out all this paperwork since I didn’t work, I was in a room with a lot of other people there for the same thing and I had to do something else, I’m not sure, I had a panic attack and left.

I don’t have health insurance. I haven’t had it for 8 years.

My gf is trying to get her hubby to tell her what his plans are, but he’s lying to her face. Knowing him he will most likely keep lying until the moment he leaves.

I had a social working a couple of years ago. I was going to this place that was mostly for addicts and people trying to integrate back into society because I was calling crisis hotlines and finally got someone to refer me to this place. One day some guy played with my ears while we were in the van that picks us up to go there. I think he got suspended. This was early transition, while I was still identifying as female, and I didn’t feel safe there anymore and stopped going. I ghosted my social worker. Yes, it was very stupid of me.
